function_question: How does nature stand tall in strong wind?

opening.text: There was a boy called Dara who loved measuring things, and his cousin Ravi said he could measure a cloud if it stood still.
Every year, Dara helped set up the school fair, with its stalls, bunting and a tall tower full of flags.
Last year, a big gust knocked the flag tower over. "This year," said Dara, "we build one that won't fall!"

card.problem: The flag tower blew over last year
card.goal: The tallest tower that survives a fan's wind
card.rules: Only paper and tape, not taped to the table

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Last year the wind knocked over the school fair's flag tower. Can you help Dara build one that won't fall? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea for a tower that stays up. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature has been standing up to storms for millions of years. Tap each card to meet four heroes who never blow over!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which paper column will hold the most books?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your tower from the side, like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your tower and face the boss levels: fan speed 1, 2 and 3. How tall can it be and still stand?
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing and take on the boss level again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, the school fair's flag tower stands tall in every wind, built the way YOU showed them.

quick_check.question: Dara's tower is 80 cm tall. At fan speed 3, the top 15 cm bends over, but the rest stands. How tall is the part still standing?
quick_check.right: Right! 80 take away 15 is 65 cm. Now can you make that top part stronger?

clue_cards.name: Bamboo
clue_cards.trick: A hollow tube with solid rings called nodes.
clue_cards.does: The rings stop it buckling, so it grows over 20 metres tall.

clue_cards.name: Grass stem
clue_cards.does: It bends right over in the wind, then springs back up.

clue_cards.name: Palm tree
clue_cards.trick: A bendy trunk and leaves that fold back.
clue_cards.does: It sways in storms and lets the wind rush past.

clue_cards.name: Termite mound
clue_cards.trick: A wide, heavy base and a narrow top.
clue_cards.does: Its shape makes it almost impossible to tip over.

predict.prompt: Tips over or stays up in the wind? Predict first!

items.label: A tall stick on a tiny base
A cone with a wide base
A tube with rings and wide legs

predict.explain: Wind pushes the top of a tower sideways. A wide base makes it much harder to tip, and a stiff, ringed tube stops the middle from folding.

lab.title: The paper column lab
lab.predict: Which paper column will hold the most books before it buckles?
